name: Miraval Berkshires Resort & Spa
positioning: All-inclusive, adults-only wellness resort in Lenox in the Berkshires, built around hundreds of activities and a large spa
best_for: Adults looking for a wellness reset with a full program of activities
Spa lovers who want a wide choice of treatments

facts.text: The resort is centrally located to attract wellness lovers from both Boston and New York City.
The resort is minutes from art galleries, summer music concerts at Tanglewood and shopping in downtown Lenox.
Miraval Berkshires offers hundreds of immersive activities and experiences, from forest bathing to floating meditation to beekeeping.
The resort's spa is the Life in Balance Spa.
Spa therapists customize one-of-a-kind body treatments.
The spa offers Ayurvedic abhyanga oil therapy.
Rooms have a calm, pared-back aesthetic rather than antiques.
The resort has a gleaming white pool area.
A Culinary and Nutrition intention teaches guests how to cook healthy, flavorful food.
Experience Planners help guests finalize their stay and itinerary.

highlights.text: The spa covers 29,000 square feet, the largest in the Berkshires and in the Miraval portfolio.
A staff beekeeper offers classes that are part ecology lesson, part self-help workshop.
Rescued horses are part of the resort's equine therapy.
An Outdoor Adventure intention focuses on connection with nature through expansive outdoor activities.

considerations.text: The resort is for guests 18 and older.
Alcohol is not included in the all-inclusive rate.
The most popular activities can fill up quickly, so guests are advised to book early.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Miraval Berkshires Resort & Spa review
